clips.title: Quest text
paras: Examine the vessel of his rebirth, mortal. It is from this that the Windseeker shall be reborn!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Will you release him from his eternal prison?

clips.title: Completion
paras: May you be protected in your crusade. May the Master bless your efforts.
